# 1. important values and setup

Change the the things accordingly

```{r setup}
# function file
source("Scripts/download.r")
source("Scripts/misc.r")

# boxes = one file per cluster for Thünen
# tiles = 10 x 10 km tiles 
run_mode <- "tiles" 
years <- c(2021, 2022, 2023)
embeddings <- c("alphaEarth", "tessera")
testing <- TRUE

# this buffer is for the Germany AOI, later we will put this to 100000 = 100km 
DE_buffer <- 100000

target_crs <- "EPSG:25832"
pixel_size <- 10 # meters
tile_size <- 10000  # 10 km x 10 km
box_extra_margin <- 20 # meters

# input files 
dir_list <- list()
csv_file <- here::here("data", "bwi2022_cluster_buffer.csv")

# this vector link is from a github "nvkelso"
vector_url <- "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nvkelso/natural-earth-vector/master/geojson/ne_10m_admin_0_countries.geojson" 

##### Tessera embeddings version #####
tessera_ver <- "v1.1"
####################################


# AlphaEarth embeddings from source.coop
aef_https <- "https://data.source.coop/tge-labs/aef/v1/annual"
aef_index_file <- "aef_index.gpkg"


# out directories
dir_list$out_dir <- here::here("output")
dir_list$cache_dir <- here::here("data", "cache")

dir_list$grid_dir <- file.path(dir_list$out_dir, "grid")
dir_list$boxes_dir <- file.path(dir_list$out_dir, "boxes")
dir_list$tiles_dir <- file.path(dir_list$out_dir, "tiles")


for (dir in dir_list){
    if(!dir.exists(dir)){
        dir.create(dir, recursive = TRUE)
        message("created missing dir: ", dir)
    }else{message("Found '", dir, "' path")}
}
```

# 2. Area of Interest: Germany + buffer zone

```{r AOI}
world <- st_read(vector_url, quiet = TRUE)
DE <- world %>% filter(ADMIN == "Germany") %>% st_transform(target_crs)
DE_buf <- st_buffer(DE, DE_buffer)

# only the countries which touches the buffer
sf_use_s2(FALSE)
neigh <- world[lengths(st_intersects(world, st_transform(DE_buf, 4326))) > 0, ]
sf_use_s2(TRUE)

land <- st_union(st_make_valid(st_transform(neigh, target_crs)))
aoi  <- st_intersection(st_geometry(DE_buf), land)
if (any(st_geometry_type(aoi) == "GEOMETRYCOLLECTION")) {
  aoi <- st_collection_extract(aoi, "POLYGON")
}

# we only need the land part that touches Germany
aoi_parts <- st_cast(aoi, "POLYGON")
DE_buf <- st_union(aoi_parts[lengths(st_intersects(aoi_parts, DE)) > 0])

# to see the geometries
# buffer_plot(DE,DE_buf)

cat(
  "Area of DE without buffer: ", sum(as.numeric(st_area(DE$geometry))) / 1e6, " km²\n",
  "Area of DE with buffer (", DE_buffer, "): ", sum(as.numeric(st_area(aoi))) / 1e6, " km²\n",
  sep = ""
)
```

# 3. BOXES for BWI

One Box per per clustor region. All rows of same cluster name belongs to the same region, so we make one box around the all of them.

```{r boxes}
cluster_plots <- read_csv(csv_file, show_col_types = FALSE)

# lets create plot id as we have at most 4 cluster plots overlapping
cluster_plots <- cluster_plots %>%
  group_by(cluster_name) %>%
  mutate(plot_id = paste0(cluster_name, "_", row_number())) %>%
  ungroup()

# saving new file
write_csv(cluster_plots, file.path(dir_list$grid_dir, "plot_ids.csv"))

# now the boxes
boxes <- cluster_plots %>%
  group_by(cluster_name) %>%
  summarise(n_rows = n(),
            xmin = min(ll_x), ymin = min(ll_y),
            xmax = max(ur_x), ymax = max(ur_y))

# lets add a margin
boxes$xmin <- floor((boxes$xmin - box_extra_margin) / pixel_size) * pixel_size
boxes$ymin <- floor((boxes$ymin - box_extra_margin) / pixel_size) * pixel_size
boxes$xmax <- ceiling((boxes$xmax + box_extra_margin) / pixel_size) * pixel_size
boxes$ymax <- ceiling((boxes$ymax + box_extra_margin) / pixel_size) * pixel_size

# size in pixels
boxes$ncol <- (boxes$xmax - boxes$xmin) / pixel_size
boxes$nrow <- (boxes$ymax - boxes$ymin) / pixel_size
boxes$wkt <- sprintf("POLYGON((%f %f, %f %f, %f %f, %f %f, %f %f))",
                     boxes$xmin, boxes$ymin, boxes$xmax, boxes$ymin, boxes$xmax, boxes$ymax,
                     boxes$xmin, boxes$ymax, boxes$xmin, boxes$ymin)
boxes_sf <- st_as_sf(boxes, wkt = "wkt", crs = target_crs)

# UTM zone of the box centre
centres <- st_transform(st_centroid(st_geometry(boxes_sf)), 4326)
boxes$utm_zone <- floor((st_coordinates(centres)[, 1] + 180) / 6) + 1
boxes_sf$utm_zone <- boxes$utm_zone

# out, saving as gpkg
st_write(boxes_sf, file.path(dir_list$grid_dir, "cluster_boxes.gpkg"), delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

print(nrow(boxes))                
```

# 4. The 10 x 10 km tiles for US

Each tile start as a multiple of 10km. Therefore every tile edge is multiple of 10000m, which is also a multiple of 10m, so every tile is exactly 10 m x 10m of our grid.
```{r tiles}
area <- st_bbox(DE_buf)
x0 <- floor(min(area["xmin"], boxes$xmin) / tile_size) * tile_size
y0 <- floor(min(area["ymin"], boxes$ymin) / tile_size) * tile_size
x1 <- ceiling(max(area["xmax"], boxes$xmax) / tile_size) * tile_size
y1 <- ceiling(max(area["ymax"], boxes$ymax) / tile_size) * tile_size

# all tiles, expanding, with lower left corners
tiles <- expand.grid(xmin = seq(x0, x1 - tile_size, by = tile_size),
                     ymin = seq(y0, y1 - tile_size, by = tile_size))
tiles$xmax <- tiles$xmin + tile_size
tiles$ymax <- tiles$ymin + tile_size
tiles$tile_id <- sprintf("E%04d_N%04d", tiles$xmin / 1000, tiles$ymin / 1000)


tiles$wkt <- sprintf("POLYGON((%f %f, %f %f, %f %f, %f %f, %f %f))",
                     tiles$xmin, tiles$ymin, tiles$xmax, tiles$ymin, tiles$xmax, tiles$ymax,
                     tiles$xmin, tiles$ymax, tiles$xmin, tiles$ymin)
tiles <- st_as_sf(tiles, wkt = "wkt", crs = target_crs)

# lets take the tiles which touches the DE_AOI or any box

tiles$in_aoi  <- st_intersects(tiles, DE_buf, sparse = FALSE)[, 1]
tiles$n_boxes <- lengths(st_intersects(tiles, boxes_sf))
tiles <- tiles[tiles$in_aoi | tiles$n_boxes > 0, ]

# UTM zones for tile 
centres <- st_transform(st_centroid(st_geometry(tiles)), 4326)
tiles$utm_zone <- floor((st_coordinates(centres)[, 1] + 180) / 6) + 1
# out, lets write this as well as pkg
st_write(tiles, file.path(dir_list$grid_dir, "tiles_10km.gpkg"), delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

print(nrow(tiles))

# just to view all the tiles and the boxes
# mapview::mapview(tiles) + mapview::mapview(boxes_sf)
```

# 5. Lets check why fixed grid for the cluster boxes

```{r grid_test}
# lets check how many boxes will be cut on different level of fixed grid size
sizes_km <- c(1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 8, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100, 150, 200, 300, 400, 500, 600, 700, 800)
grid_test <- data.frame(size_km = sizes_km, boxes_cut = NA)
for (i in 1:nrow(grid_test)) {
  grid_test$boxes_cut[i] <- count_cut_boxes(grid_test$size_km[i] * 1000)
  print(grid_test[i, ])
}

plot(grid_test$size_km, grid_test$boxes_cut + 1, log = "xy", type = "b", pch = 19,
     xlab = "tile size (km)", ylab = "cluster boxes cut",
     main = "how many boxes does it cut")
```

here we see that with each size of grid keeps cutting the custer boxes till we have the largest size of grid which is almost the length of whole Germany from north to south (800 km). Therefore we are taking individual boxes for each cluster box.

# 7. Alpha Earth 
```{r aef_test}
aef_base <- paste0("/vsicurl/", aef_https)
aef_index_online <- paste0(aef_base, "/", aef_index_file)

st_layers(aef_index_online)
```


##############################################
```{r aef_index}
aef_index_saved <- file.path(dir_list$cache_dir, "aef_index_aoi.gpkg")

# only if the aef_index gpkg doesnot exist 
if (!file.exists(aef_index_saved)) {
  layer_name <- st_layers(aef_index_online)$name[1]

  # the AOI plus one tile size on each side
  b <- st_bbox(DE_buf)
  b <- st_bbox(c(xmin = b[["xmin"]] - tile_size, ymin = b[["ymin"]] - tile_size, # increasing on tile_size
                 xmax = b[["xmax"]] + tile_size, ymax = b[["ymax"]] + tile_size), crs = st_crs(target_crs))

  # st_segmentize() adds a point every 1 km along the edges, because a straight edge in metres
  # is a little curved in longitude / latitude, and 4 corners alone would cut that curve off
  b_lonlat <- st_transform(st_segmentize(st_as_sfc(b), 1000), 4326)
  our_area <- st_as_text(st_as_sfc(st_bbox(b_lonlat)))

  aef_index  <- st_read(aef_index_online, layer = layer_name, wkt_filter = our_area, quiet = TRUE)
  st_write(aef_index, aef_index_saved, quiet = TRUE)
}
aef_index <- st_read(aef_index_saved, quiet = TRUE)

# find the column with the file names (its values end with .tiff)
path_col <- NA
for (col in names(aef_index)) {
  if (is.character(aef_index[[col]]) && any(grepl("tiff$", aef_index[[col]]))) {
    path_col <- col
  }
}

# keep only "<year>/<zone>/<file>.tiff" from the path and put our address in front
aef_index$url <- file.path(aef_base, sub(".*/annual/", "", aef_index[[path_col]]))

print(table(aef_index$year))   # number of files per year in AOI
```

# 8. Main Functions

```{r}
if (run_mode == "boxes") {
  out_root <- dir_list$boxes_dir
  areas <- data.frame(name = sprintf("cluster_%07d", boxes$cluster_name),
                      xmin = boxes$xmin, ymin = boxes$ymin, xmax = boxes$xmax, ymax = boxes$ymax,
                      utm_zone = boxes$utm_zone, size = boxes$n_rows)
} else {
  out_root <- dir_list$tiles_dir
  areas <- data.frame(name = tiles$tile_id,
                      xmin = tiles$xmin, ymin = tiles$ymin, xmax = tiles$xmax, ymax = tiles$ymax,
                      utm_zone = tiles$utm_zone, size = tiles$n_boxes)
}

# test run: 5 boxes in UTM zone 32 and 5 in zone 33, or the 2 tiles with the most boxes
if (testing) {
  z32 <- areas[areas$utm_zone == 32, ]
  z33 <- areas[areas$utm_zone == 33, ]
  if (run_mode == "boxes") {
    areas <- rbind(head(z32, 5), head(z33, 5))
  } else {
    areas <- rbind(z32[which.max(z32$size), ], z33[which.max(z33$size), ])
  }
}

# one folder per year with different embeddings folder
for (y in years) {
  for (p in embeddings) {
    dir.create(file.path(out_root, y, p), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
  }
}
message("run_mode: ", run_mode, ", areas to do: ", nrow(areas))

for (i in 1:nrow(areas)) {
  a <- areas[i, ]
  template <- rast(ext(a$xmin, a$xmax, a$ymin, a$ymax), res = pixel_size, crs = target_crs)

  for (year in years) {
    for (p in embeddings) {
      out_file <- file.path(out_root, year, p, paste0(a$name, ".tif"))
      if (file.exists(out_file)) next     # already done in an earlier run

      message(Sys.time(), "  ", i, "/", nrow(areas), "  ", a$name, "  ", p, " ", year)

      if (p == "alphaEarth") {
        emb <- try(get_aef(template, year))
      } else {
        emb <- try(get_tessera(template, year))
      }
      if (inherits(emb, "try-error") || is.null(emb)) {
        message("  failed, this one is tried again in the next run")
        next
      }

      save_raster(emb, out_file, int8 = (p == "alphaEarth"))
      rm(emb)
      gc()
    }
  }
}
```

# 9. Checking Files

```{r checker}
# 1. each year, type of embeddings, how many files.
for (y in years) {
  for (p in embeddings) {
    n <- length(list.files(file.path(out_root, y, p), pattern = "\\.tif$"))
    print(paste(y, p, n, "files"))
  }
}

# embedding dir for first year
aef_dir <- file.path(out_root, years[1], "alphaEarth")
tes_dir <- file.path(out_root, years[1], "tessera")

# 2. comparing both embeddings geometry
both <- intersect(list.files(aef_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$"), list.files(tes_dir, pattern = "\\.tif$"))
for (f in head(both, 5)) {
  a <- rast(file.path(aef_dir, f))
  b <- rast(file.path(tes_dir, f))
  print(paste(f, compareGeom(a, b, stopOnError = FALSE), nlyr(a), nlyr(b))) # with layers as well
}

# 3. are the file edges on 10m grid
print(all(as.vector(ext(rast(file.path(aef_dir, both[1])))) %% pixel_size == 0))

# 4. Same file for a pixel in differnt year
for (y in years) {
  same <- compareGeom(rast(file.path(aef_dir, both[1])), rast(file.path(out_root, y, "alphaEarth", both[1])),
                      stopOnError = FALSE)
  print(paste(y, same))
}

```
